command: async (page) => { const promise=page.waitForResponse(r=>r.url().includes('/versions') && r.request().method()==='POST'); await page.getByTestId('btn-confirm-publish').click(); const r=await promise; await page.getByTestId('flow-done').waitFor(); return {status:r.status(),body:await r.json(),rendered:await page.getByTestId('flow-done').innerText()}; }
